protocol.name: public-feedback-v2
protocol.comparison: one shared fresh initial call per task; control snapshot vs optional correction
protocol.feedback: at most one correction; cumulative 15000 tokens; same <=6000-char refreshed seeds; no tools
protocol.retention: keep correction only if Reproduce and Preserve pass; otherwise retain initial patch
protocol.accounting: initial calls overlap both arms; actual usage is candidate cumulative usage, not sum of arms
protocol.authoring: handwritten from descriptions/original APIs; author exposed to earlier outcomes; not blind
protocol.reference_use: offline certification only; no reference code/private tests in model input
protocol.stop_gate: development net gain >=2, controls not worse; otherwise stop this policy; no heldout this run
